meta.name: spark-optimization
meta.description: Optimize Apache Spark jobs with partitioning, caching, shuffle optimization, and memory tuning. Use when improving Spark performance, debugging slow jobs, or scaling data processing pipelines.

copy.tagline: 优化大数据处理作业的性能与资源占用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的数据作业常因Spark性能问题而卡顿或烧钱。
copy.tagline_en: Speed up Spark jobs and lower resource usage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Spark pipelines and often face slow jobs or high resource bills.

howto.what: 当你想优化 Apache Spark(大数据处理框架)里的作业时,Claude 会提供关于数据分区、缓存、中间结果传输和内存配置的调优建议与示例代码,包括启用自适应查询优化、使用列式文件等做法。
howto.when: 当用户需要改进 Spark 性能、排查运行缓慢的作业或扩展数据处理管道时触发。

say.text: 我的 Spark 作业运行很慢,能帮我优化吗?
say.note: Claude 会分析并给出调优步骤和配置建议。

say.text: 数据倾斜严重,该怎么解决?
say.note: Claude 会提供加盐、广播连接等方法。

say.text: 帮我设置 Spark 的内存和分区参数。
say.note: Claude 会给出相应配置的代码示例。

howto.what_en: Provides optimization advice and code samples for Apache Spark jobs, covering partitioning, caching, shuffle, and memory tuning, plus enabling adaptive query execution and using columnar file formats.
howto.when_en: Triggered when improving Spark performance, debugging slow jobs, or scaling data processing pipelines.

say_en.text: My Spark job is slow. Can you help me optimize it?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest tuning steps.

say_en.text: Data skew is severe. How should I fix it?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest salting and broadcast joins.

say_en.text: Help me set Spark memory and partition parameters.
